killedBy: createWorldFor's init object (issue #493) takes every knob by name, so a new rule cannot grow its signature
why: A key silently dropped from the destructure, which is the failure mode a positional list could not have: a missing positional is an arity error, a missing destructured key is a default. Every versus board would then load for one player -- no co-players placed, no stock, no teams -- while the world still builds, still steps, and still reports the mode it was asked for. Scoped here rather than to the versus suites because the point is the DESTRUCTURE, not the behaviour any one caller depends on; the killing case drives every knob in one call with each value off its default, so whichever key is dropped fails it.
